query.description: NCVS Select records from BJS's API (one row per victimization, person or household, 1993 on, with weights): filter with $where and pick columns with $select. Aggregate SoQL (sum, count, $group) is refused by the site's bot check: aggregate the rows with compute.

dataset.desc: personal_victimization, personal_population, household_victimization, household_population (or the 4x4 id)

$select.desc: plain columns only, comma-separated: year, newcrime, newoff, newwgt

$where.desc: SoQL filter; every column is text, so quote values: year = '2024' AND newcrime = '1'

$order.desc: SoQL order; default :id gives stable paging

statistical_table.description: One CSV table from a BJS report's table package (zip): Criminal Victimization, Prisoners, Jail Inmates, Probation and Parole, Capital Punishment. Default: every line numbered (row, col1...) to find the header lines; then header_lines (e.g. '11-12') names the columns.

report.desc: report package code or alias: cv24 (criminal_victimization_2024), p23st, ji24st, ppus23, cp22st ...

member.desc: the table's file in the zip, e.g. cv24t01.csv (t = table, at = appendix table, f = figure); a glob works

header_lines.desc: the table's header line numbers, e.g. '11-12' (read them from a first fetch without it)

header_row.desc: one header line instead of header_lines; 0 (default) returns every line numbered

carry.desc: which header lines span to the right over blank cells: top (default), all, none; check the names against the numbered lines

personal_victimization.name: NCVS Select - Personal Victimization
personal_victimization.description: One row per personal victimization (rape/sexual assault, robbery, aggravated and simple assault, personal theft), 1993-2024, with victim and incident characteristics; weight newwgt (series-adjusted) gives victimizations.

personal_population.name: NCVS Select - Personal Population
personal_population.description: Every interviewed person age 12 or older by quarter, 1993-2024, with demographics; weight wgtpercy gives persons (the rate denominator); victim and wgt_ovam_per for prevalence.

household_victimization.name: NCVS Select - Household Victimization
household_victimization.description: One row per household property victimization (burglary/trespassing, motor-vehicle theft, other theft), 1993-2024; weight newwgt.

household_population.name: NCVS Select - Household Population
household_population.description: Every interviewed household by quarter, 1993-2024; weight wgthhcy gives households (the property-crime rate denominator).

criminal_victimization_2024.name: Criminal Victimization, 2024 (NCJ 310547) tables
criminal_victimization_2024.description: Official NCVS numbers, rates per 1,000 and standard errors: violent and property victimization by type of crime 2020-2024 (cv24t01...), reporting to police, victim characteristics; appendix tables back to 1993 (cv24at01).

prisoners_2023.name: Prisoners in 2023 - Statistical Tables (NCJ 310197)
prisoners_2023.description: National Prisoner Statistics: prisoners under state and federal jurisdiction by state and sex, imprisonment rates, admissions and releases, by offense, race and age (p23stt01 ... p23stt24, p23stat01 appendix).

jail_inmates_2024.name: Jail Inmates in 2024 - Statistical Tables
jail_inmates_2024.description: Annual Survey of Jails: jail population, incarceration rates, admissions, turnover, conviction status (ji24stt01 ...).

probation_parole_2023.name: Probation and Parole in the United States, 2023
probation_parole_2023.description: Annual Probation and Parole Surveys: adults on probation and parole by state, entries and exits (ppus23t01 ..., figures ppus23f..).

capital_punishment_2022.name: Capital Punishment, 2022 - Statistical Tables
capital_punishment_2022.description: Prisoners under sentence of death and executions by state and year.
